definitions.explanation: The area of land along the edge of the sea. The boundary between land and ocean.

examples.japanese: {海岸|かいがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}きました→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

examples.english: I go to the beach in summer.

examples.english: I looked at the sea from the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{海岸|かいがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children are playing on the beach.

examples.english: This beach is quiet and beautiful, so I come here every summer.

notes:
{海岸|かいがん} refers to the coastline or seashore—the boundary where land meets the ocean. It's a general term for coastal areas.

ETYMOLOGY: Combines ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) + ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧ (shore/bank).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {海岸|かいがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the shore
- {海岸|かいがん}⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: coastline
- {海岸|かいがん}⟦{沿|ぞ}い→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the coast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧: sandy beach (specific type)
- ⟦{浜辺|はまべ}→浜辺：17948_hamabe⟧: beach, seashore (slightly more poetic)
- ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧: seaside, by the sea
- ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧: shore, bank (general, also for rivers)

Japan is an island nation with extensive coastlines, making {海岸|かいがん} a frequently used word in geography and daily life.
